ui_bugs.issue: Splash sessionStorage gate is INCOMPLETE. The flag 'nc_splash_shown' is SET on teardown (line 120) but never READ to seed initial state — useState(true) is unconditional (line 68). Result: splash reappears on every full page load (new tab to /, hard navigation between top-level routes via window.location, deep-link load), contradicting the spec line: 'Open a new tab to / on the same browser session — splash should also NOT reappear (sessionStorage nc_splash_shown=1)'. Verified: visited / (splash 2.6s, flag set to 1), then page.goto('/landing-page') — splash showed again for ~2.2s before content rendered. Fix is one line: useState(() => { try { return sessionStorage.getItem('nc_splash_shown') !== '1'; } catch { return true; } }).

action_items: Fix App.js bootSplash useState seeding to honour sessionStorage 'nc_splash_shown' so splash does NOT re-show on subsequent full page loads in same browser session. One-line change at line 68.

rca_of_the_issue: Splash gate bug RCA: spec requires splash to display only once per browser session, gated by sessionStorage 'nc_splash_shown'. App.js line 120 SETS the flag on splash teardown, but line 68 declares `const [bootSplash, setBootSplash] = useState(true)` — initial state is always true, never reading sessionStorage. So on any new page load (new tab, hard refresh of any route, or full navigation), the splash mounts for 2.6s before clearing again. Reproduction: open / (splash shows, flag set), then page.goto('/landing-page') in same context → splash shows again ~2.2s. Mitigation (1 line): replace `useState(true)` with `useState(() => { try { return sessionStorage.getItem('nc_splash_shown') !== '1'; } catch { return true; } })`. After fix, also short-circuit setSplashShown timer when initial state is false.
